image named by the shipped shader 'textures/cosmo_sfx/diamond_blue' that no pinned archive provides. ParseStage returns qfalse when R_FindImageFile fails, and R_FindShader then sets shader.defaultShader for the *whole* shader (ioq3 code/renderergl2/tr_shader.c), so every surface drawn through it renders untextured rather than losing one layer. Accepted because the audit measured how much geometry that is.
